shortDescription: Collect facts from remote devices running Cisco SMB

options.name: gather_subset
options.description: When supplied, this argument will restrict the facts collected to a given subset.  Possible values for this argument include C(all), C(hardware), C(config) and C(interfaces).  Can specify a list of values to include a larger subset.  Values can also be used with an initial C(!) to specify that a specific subset should not be collected.
